title: Wire the missing advisory rows onto the Pi belt: activity, tools-logger, PreCompact
action: The Pi belt wires four advisory rules today and the Claude belt fires more. Add the missing ones. FIRST, activity: the Claude manifest fires it on eight events (UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PermissionRequest, Stop, Notification, SessionEnd) — derive that list yourself from packages/bee/hooks/claude-hooks.json, never from this prose. Map each one onto the Pi event that carries the same meaning and call it through the belt's existing runAdvisoryHook helper, passing the CLAUDE event name in hook_event_name, because activity is a state machine keyed on Claude names (read its map_event and sticky_suppresses before choosing). Record the chosen mapping as a comment block in the belt so a later reader can audit it; a Claude row with no honest Pi carrier is named in that comment instead of forced onto a wrong event. SECOND, tools-logger: call it from the tool_result handler. Pi's tool_result carries toolName, toolCallId, input, content, details, isError and usage — pass what maps, and OMIT the Claude-shaped fields Pi does not carry rather than guessing values for them. THIRD, PreCompact per b1a26071: register pi.on("session_before_compact") and call session-close with hook_event_name PreCompact. That handler MUST return nothing — Pi treats a returned object there as a cancel or a custom compaction, so a stray return would silently kill the user's /compact. All three rows are ADVISORY and fail OPEN: each owns its own try/catch, none throws, none returns a value to Pi that could block, and the passivity check still short-circuits when no .bee directory is present. Do not touch runBlockingHook, mapToolCall, or anything on the tool_call path. Then extend the parity test: the pinned advisory-name list must grow to cover the new rules, the derived event set must include the new pi.on registration, and add probes for a correct activity state transition per mapped event, for a well-formed tools-logger line built only from fields Pi actually carries, for the PreCompact handler returning nothing, and for the BEE_HERDING_WORKER case where activity is the one hook that does not short-circuit while every other belt call still does.

truths: activity is called for every Claude row the manifest fires it on, or that row is named in the belt's mapping comment as having no honest Pi carrier
activity receives the Claude event name in hook_event_name, and a probe asserts the resulting state transition is the correct one, not merely that the call exited 0
tools-logger appends one well-formed line built only from fields Pi's tool_result carries; the Claude-shaped optionals are absent, never invented
the session_before_compact handler returns nothing, and a probe proves a compaction is never cancelled by bee
under BEE_HERDING_WORKER activity still runs and every other belt call short-circuits
every new handler is advisory and fail-open: a deny, crash, missing binary or unparseable verdict is swallowed and logged, never thrown
the blocking path is untouched: deny, crash, missing binary and unparseable still block on tool_call

artifacts.substantive: new runAdvisoryHook calls for activity and tools-logger, a pi.on session_before_compact handler returning nothing, and a comment block recording the Claude-row to Pi-event mapping; no TODO stubs
pinned advisory-name list grown, plus the transition, tools-logger field-shape, PreCompact-returns-nothing and herded-pane probes
